known_characteristics: Continuous numeric target: daily revenue (10420–82035, mean ~42k)
730 rows of daily data — 2-year time series
promotions_spend has very strong correlation with revenue: r=0.879
Seasonal pattern: 25% amplitude annual sine wave
Weekly pattern: weekends 30% lower than weekdays
Clean data, no nulls, no quality issues
Features include date, region, channel, promotions_spend, units_sold, returns_pct, new_customers

task_type.note: Revenue is a continuous numeric target. Both regression and time_series_forecasting are correct framings. binary_classification, multiclass_classification, clustering, or anomaly_detection would all be wrong.

class_balance_issue.note: Continuous regression target — class balance does not apply. Reporting class_balance_issue=true would indicate the model misidentified the task type.

data_readiness.note: Clean data so 'ready' is correct for a baseline. 'needs_prep' is also acceptable if the skill flags date feature extraction (day-of-week, month, lag features) or seasonality encoding — these are legitimate preprocessing steps for time series regression. 'insufficient' is incorrect.

target_analysis.note: No class balance analysis applies. The skill should report continuous target statistics (mean, range, skewness) instead.

recommendations.key_insight_note: promotions_spend has r=0.879 correlation with revenue — the strongest signal in the dataset. A high-quality recommendation must explicitly mention this feature's importance or its linear relationship with revenue.
